title: Edit a 150 KB one-line JSON file without disturbing it
prompt:
site/flags.min.json is our feature-flag file (see site/README.md for how it has to stay formatted). Please make these changes to it and nothing else:

1. services.billing.retry.max_attempts becomes 7.
2. The flag beta_checkout_v2 is renamed to checkout_v2: same value, same position in the file.
3. team-orion was dissolved: remove every flag whose owner is team-orion.
4. Bump version by one.

Everything else must stay byte for byte as it is, formatting included.
